name: RadialChart
label: Radial chart
description: Concentric progress rings for completion and KPI readouts.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the values, tooltips and value axis are written in, such as `de-DE`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: data
props.description: Array of data items — each renders as a concentric ring

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Maximum value for the radial scale (100 = percentage)

props.name: title
props.description:
Chart title, in the shared chart header; it also names the figure.
Note: this replaces the native `title` tooltip attribute, which the chart does not expose.

props.name: summaryItems
props.description: Summary stats displayed in the header

props.name: innerRadius
props.description: Inner radius of the innermost ring

props.name: outerRadius
props.description: Outer radius of the outermost ring

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Headline printed in the donut hole, e.g. "46%"; pairs best with showLegend false, since the legend shifts the rings above centre

props.name: centerSublabel
props.description: Small caption under the centre headline

props.name: bare
props.description: Strip the card chrome (border, padding, fill) when the chart sits inside another panel that supplies the surface

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the wrapper
